description: Prepare one unsigned XRPL transaction for agent-local signing. Choose exactly one transaction_type and provide its typed XRPL parameters in parameters. N9T2 routes established transaction types to their existing validators/builders and supports additional XRPL models including Clawback, DID, OracleSet/OracleDelete, TicketCreate, NFTokenModify, and XChain operations. Omit sequence, fee, and last_ledger_sequence to autofill them. N9T2 never receives private keys, seeds, or wallet secrets and never signs transactions server-side. This is the generic unsigned transaction-construction primitive for supported XRPL transaction types including Payment, TrustSet, OfferCreate, and OfferCancel. The caller signs locally before submission.

parameters.description: Typed XRPL transaction fields used to build the unsigned transaction. Sequence, fee, and last_ledger_sequence may be autofilled when omitted.
parameters.title: Parameters

transaction_type.description: XRPL transaction model name to prepare, selected from the supported transaction types advertised by this tool.
transaction_type.title: Transaction Type
